provenance.sourceState: The harness file was added to a checkout of that commit before any other change; the RN Focus screen, filter sheet and selections hook were unchanged.
provenance.manualAdjustment: 2026-09-24: moved the existing Next Actions section before Review Due in 74 observations for Focus #1281; original RN capture inputs and section content are unchanged. This was not recaptured from runtime.
provenance.recapture: 2026-09-26 (task rn-focus-menu-bugs-20260924-01): recaptured with MINDWTR_CAPTURE_FOCUS_CONTROLS=1 after two RN fixes. (1) useTaskFilterSelections drops an applied saved filter's selections for hidden sections: observations 1-3 of "priority rules with priorities off" now show priorities [] and More filters "All". (2) markSavedFilterDeleted changes only the deleted entry: observations 2-3 of "delete saved filters" now write sf-list with its stored view "list" in stored order, so "List only" no longer appears in the Focus saved row. Every other observation and every input is byte-identical.
